evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/mempool.cpp to optimize MempoolInfoToJSON.
rationale: Avoids copying the entire unbroadcast transaction ID set under lock when calling getmempoolinfo. While unbroadcast sets are typically small, author microbenchmarks demonstrate this eliminates query scaling up to ~0.9 ms at 10,000 entries.
